svg.title: Proposed temperature-control conceptual circuit
svg.desc: Conceptual circuit, not a fabrication release. Three 10 kilohm beta3977 NTC sensors are buffered with MCP6002 and filtered before ADC sampling. A PIC18F57Q43 asserts a shared active-low fault through a P2N2222A open collector. A fused external9 volt input supplies a7805 and optional locally powered fan. Physical pin mapping and component ratings require review.
svg.text: Proposed design · not a fabrication release · named signals are net labels; physical MCU pins remain TBD.
100 nF at each IC; 10 µF input + output bulk.
Nano + IC decoupling, LEDs and extra testpoints off-sheet.
Check 7805 temperature rise at final load.
Probe connector J3 · divider return → GND
Probe connector J4 · divider return → GND
Probe connector J5 · divider return → GND
Hotter NTC → lower ADC voltage. Open / short leads approach a rail. Thresholds and diagnostic windows need bench validation.
Example policy: warn 50°C · trip 60°C · all ≤45°C + manual rearm after valid sensors.
JP1 isolates local sink. Fit JP2 only for standalone tests. One agreed bus pullup. No power-loss shutdown guarantee.
Other pins follow the team bus map.
No 5 V or 9 V supply on ribbon.
Spare U3B: + → midpoint of R11/R12 (10 kΩ each, 5 V/GND); − → output. Details off-sheet.
F / OPTIONAL LOCAL 9 V FAN DRIVER
REVIEW BEFORE BUILD: package pinouts · NTC mounting · fan + fuse ratings · regulator thermal budget · bus pull-up · ADC calibration · trip response.
